svg.text: CAFETERIA FACILITIES · LITERAL ROOM CONTEXT
CURRENT PRODUCTION PIXELS · ACCEPTED CHEF-WHITE + STEEL STAFF FOR SCALE ONLY
The room is deliberately schematic: real office walls, grid, real footprints, real current sprites, and static people for scale. This is not a Unity behavior proof and does not claim
cafeteria staff can be surfaced in game yet.
NORMAL GAMEPLAY SCALE · 90 px/CELL
FAR GAMEPLAY SCALE · 40 px/CELL
ROOM INVENTORY
BACK SERVICE WALL
Serving line · attendance scanner · commercial range · prep table · dish return
· walk-in cooler · tray stack
DINING FLOOR
Communal table · solitary dining carrel · workers and office cast are static
scale references
DASHED BOXES
Existing gameplay footprints. Multi-cell props retain one 128×128 sprite
centered or baseline-aligned inside that footprint.
1 · FUNCTIONAL READ
Do the service line, scanner, range, prep surface, dish return, cooler, carrel,
communal table, and tray stack each read without labels at normal scale?
2 · FAMILY + PROJECTION
Do the steel food-service pieces feel related, while the plan-projected dining
pieces remain coherent beside elevation-projected kitchen equipment?
3 · EXTRACTION DECISION
Approval means these exact current pixels become canonical SVG extraction
targets. Corrections happen before sources or production wiring are touched.
HARD GATE
Nothing in this review creates assets/props SVGs, changes src/props/templates.ts, runs the prop importer, alters defaults or export contracts, exports a browser bundle, or touches Unity. The
next step only begins after an explicit visual approval or a concrete correction list.
SOURCE OWNERSHIP AUDIT
All nine are genuine code-owned gaps today: handwritten ShapeSpec builders with zero parameters and no entries in the QuotaCo Workhorse generated art module. That makes one static canonical
SVG per facility the likely later source shape, pending this visual call.
REVIEW QUESTION
Approve these current pixels as the nine extraction targets, or name the facilities that need redesign first.
